invariants.rationale: If 'orders' were null, a NullPointerException would occur before this point, so it must be non-null at method exit.
The method throws for any null element, so all orders must be non-null at exit.
The method throws if any order has quantity <= 0, so all orders must have positive quantity.
The method throws if any order has negative unit price, so all orders must have unit price >= 0.
Reinforces that no order in the list fails the validation criteria enforced in this method.
